indexDecode.riskIfWrong: A single incorrect previous index, indexDelta read, or cursor position can shift subsequent entity indexes.

commandDecode.riskIfWrong: A cursor shift before command read can reinterpret two bits as a different operation.

payloadBitsMechanism.normalCursorRole: In unfiltered UPDATE/CREATE parsing, field extraction advances entityData through EntityMutationExtractor. payloadBits is primarily diagnostic or used for bounded skips in filter/recovery paths.
payloadBitsMechanism.knownRisk: Prior packet-953 work showed payloadBits and field-level read counts can diverge, so treating payloadBits as canonical cursor movement remains unsafe without further evidence.
